description: Get a price quote and unsigned transaction for swapping tokens on SunSwap DEX. Returns an unsigned TX for client-side signing. After signing, submit via execute_swap. Requires API key.

amountIn.description: Amount to swap in smallest unit (SUN for TRX, base units for tokens)

fromToken.description: Token to sell — symbol (USDT, TRX, SUN, ...) or TRC-20 contract address

toToken.description: Token to buy — symbol or TRC-20 contract address

name: get_swap_quote
title: Get Swap Quote
